original_intent: Solve the four active GitHub Issues created by worldofgeese in DecapodLabs/decapod.
derived_intent: Implement compatible, tested fixes for #1311, #1312, #1313, and #1314 and deliver them through one PR with refreshed governance evidence.
active_boundaries: Work only in the claimed Decapod worktree; do not hand-edit .decapod state or the shared control-plane database.
repo_scope: Rust runtime, CLI contracts, governance artifact serialization, tests, living specs, and one PR for issues #1311-#1314.
evidence: Issue #1311 regression: malformed local decapod.db no longer blocks isolated specs.refresh.
Issue #1312 compatibility slice: prior run remains loadable from trajectory-runs while trajectory.json remains current pointer.
Issue #1313 compatibility slice: standalone events use the shared write pool and data db verify is read-only; automatic repair is deferred.
Issue #1314 regression: absolute trajectory and validation paths are normalized or redacted.
unresolved_assumptions: Automatic dump/reload recovery requires a Dactyl-native API and explicit human decision.
The additive archive is evidence retention only; validation and publication continue to trust trajectory.json.
The full library suite has four pre-existing environment-sensitive failures unrelated to this change.
The write pool improves same-process serialization but does not prove cross-process locking.
